scenes.headline: How a card draws itself in dots
scenes.sub: The Generative effect skill from transitions.dev, read line by line.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gudgeon! An agent skill makes any card look as if an agent is building it, dot by dot. No model draws those dots.

scenes.label: What is new
scenes.text: The runtime measures the real element, draws a dotted wireframe of exactly that, then reveals the element behind a scan line.
scenes.say: The idea: measure the real element, draw a dotted wireframe of exactly that, then reveal it behind a scan line.

scenes.title: What it reads before the first frame
scenes.say: First, it walks the element once.

items.say: Boxes: backgrounds, borders, buttons and images.
Text lines, from the browser's own line rectangles.
And key elements, which get guides and size labels.

scenes.title: One build, one function of progress

steps.say: The element goes in once, and gets measured.
Out comes a list of parts, each with a start time.
Every frame, one function takes the build's progress and redraws everything.
It draws into an overlay on top. The real element stays in the page.

scenes.title: How a dotted line is drawn

parts.note: a zero-length dash with a round cap is one dot
parts.say: A dash of zero length with a round cap is one dot, every four point eight pixels.

parts.note: more dots, more of the line drawn
parts.say: More dots, more line. Slide the offset, and the dots flow.

scenes.title: A photo in four passes
scenes.say: A photo is read from its pixels.

items.say: A contour sketch of its tones.
A halftone, painted once onto a canvas.
Dots in the photo's own colours.
Then the photo, out of a blur.

scenes.label: SVG circles in one demo card's dot field, rewritten every frame
scenes.note: Heart Rate Monitor card, 332 by 345 px
scenes.say: The cost is the dot field. One demo card has seven hundred and eighty-four circles, touched every frame.

scenes.text: The skill holds the judgement, the runtime holds the craft. The agent picks the element and the moment.
scenes.say: The skill picks the variant and the moment. The fixed runtime does the drawing.
To recap: measure first, draw dots with dashes, and keep it to one showcase element.
